notes.title: We're looking for playtesters! Help balance the game and find bugs!
notes.content:
Hello players!

We're currently looking for playtesters to help balance the game and find bugs!

Playtesters will be given access to development versions of the game, where they'll help balance the game, find bugs and/or issues, and supply suggestions to help improve the game.

There is currently only one way to apply to become a playtester, and that's through our Google form. If you'd like to apply please click the link below and fill out the form, selected players will be contacted through Discord.

All requirements are listed below.

Please note this is not a paid position within Altozose and playtesters will only be rewarded with in-game content.

Internal Playtester Application

Requirements

 Must speak English.
 Must have a Discord account.

notes.title: Major updates! - Dog Clicker v1.0.0
notes.content:
Hello players!

Welcome to the first major update of Dog Clicker, version 1.0.0!

This update includes many changes to how your game data is handled and stored, along with changes to the UI to include new elements! A full list of updates can be viewed below!

Along with this patch, we will be transitioning out of early access and into a full release!

What does this mean for previous players?

Due to the changes on how data is handled and stored, all previous user data will be lost.

We know this may upset some players, and in the case that you are affected by this and would like compensation please feel free to send us an email with your new Player ID attached (this can be found within the settings menu in the game). 

Players who were affected will be compensated with 1,000 gems to give them a boost if they so please.

You can send us an email at support@altozose.com .

Patch Notes

Gameplay Changes

 Tokens will no longer go negative after reaching a certain point.
 Previous issues causing certain dogs to be lost has been resolved.
 Achievements are slowly being added and rolled out, giving players certain goals to reach within the game.
 Gems are now purchasable through the in-game store.
 Various small balance changes.


UI Changes

 New "Dogs" menu, allowing you to view which dogs you have unlocked.
 New "Gacha" menu, allowing you to view the available gacha dogs and rarity chances.
 Version number can now be seen within the loading menu.

notes.title: Welcome to Dog Clicker! - Submit a Dog!
notes.content:
Hello players!

Welcome to Dog Clicker! A mix between a clicker and a gacha game!

We're planning our release for January 6th @ 12:00 PM PST, but we require your help!

At the moment, the game is lacking a few things. The main one being the core component of the game, dogs. We want to reach out to the community and get some insight from them on what kind of dogs they'd like in the game. So we've come up with a solution...

Submit a Dog!

If you'd like a chance for your own custom dog to be in the game, please fill out this form! We're looking to add in as many dogs as possible, so now is your chance!

Click here to fill out the form!

Any ideas that we choose to use will receive a reward! At the games release we'll give you a unique "Creator Dog" and a good amount of gems directly into your account!

We appreciate your time and support! Thank you for reading through!

See you January 6th!
